open-access-art:nga:30230: A narrow stream catches the light beneath a web of trunks and branches. The small figures almost dissolve into Corot’s green woodland, inviting us to notice how softly human activity sits within the larger landscape.
open-access-art:nga:62296: Birds fill the branches, bank and water around a great tree. Bright feathers punctuate the subdued woodland, while an open music book turns this gathering into an imagined concert: a scene to explore one small performer at a time.
open-access-art:nga:214118: A cut watermelon glows against the dark background, its scattered seeds and torn flesh brought close to the viewer. Beside it, translucent grapes catch smaller points of light, contrasting crisp rind with soft, yielding fruit.
open-access-art:nga:50577: Dense leaves and hanging fronds almost swallow the small figures and canoe along the riverbank. The oval view compresses the forest into a close wall of green, with patches of light guiding the eye through its layered vegetation.
open-access-art:nga:52261: Broad strokes of pale paint join sea and cloudy sky above a quiet strip of beach. Tiny figures and distant sails give scale to the open shore, while the dark trees at the left make the soft light feel more expansive.
open-access-art:nga:66765: An open gate leads the eye into a sandy track beneath a wind-bent tree. The leaning fence and exposed branches echo one another, setting a restless foreground against the slower movement of clouds and distant countryside.
open-access-art:nga:177895: Patches of green and ochre climb toward blue mountain peaks beneath billowing clouds. The simplified fields make the hillside feel almost pieced together, while scattered trees give a sense of scale to the broad sweep of land.
open-access-art:nga:46037: A feathered hat and pale sleeve emerge from a dark background as a young woman faces a man seen from behind. Their close arrangement draws attention to faces, gesture and the small area of light between them.
open-access-art:nga:195800: Wagons, animals and people pause beneath a pink evening sky. Cooking, tending livestock and gathering water divide the foreground into small scenes of work, turning the grand view of travel into a collection of daily tasks.
open-access-art:nga:34082: A bright white neckcloth frames the sitter’s face against dark curls and a rich red coat. His sideways glance and restrained smile give the formal portrait a sense of a moment caught in conversation.
